questions.question: Does the added assertion check the record name the refinement command prints?
questions.risk: The test passes without naming the missing record.

questions.question: Does S1 (duplicate-block at line 89) show at the reviewed head, is the path generated or excluded, and do lines 89-94 repeat lines 82-87?
questions.risk: A scanner violation posts without a check.

questions.question: Is the temporary body file removed when the assertion fails?
questions.risk: A failed run leaves a temporary file behind.

questions.question: Does the added block match the style of the neighbouring parse-error cases?
questions.risk: The new case reads differently from its siblings.

questions.question: Does a body without the acceptance-evidence record exit 2 and name that record?
